v5.welcome: Welcome to Tsing Hua. Meet students, observe buildings and explore at your own pace.
v5.served: Meal and drinks enjoyed; supplies replenished.
v5.approach: Approach a student, doorway or refreshment point, then press E.
v5.quest_done: A campus journey is complete. Check your journal for details.
v5.bike_on: Cycling. Press B or the bicycle button again to dismount.
v5.camera_hint: Approach a building before taking a photograph.
v5.empty_supply: Supplies are empty. Visit a cafeteria or water point.
v5.drank: You had a drink of water.
v5.room_hint: Approach one of the facilities listed at the side and press E.
v5.rested: You rested and recovered your energy.
v5.water_filled: You had a drink and refilled your bottle.
v5.observe.books: You read about campus. An observation was added to your journal.
v5.observe.terminal: You checked the public terminal and noted campus information.
v5.observe.archive: You read an archival introduction and made a historical observation.
v5.observe.notice: You read the public notice and learned about campus activities.
v5.observe.desk: You organized the desk and reviewed course notes.
v5.observe.exhibit: You studied the display and recorded an observation.
v5.controls: WASD Move   E Interact   M Map   Q Journal   C Dorm Guide
v5.dorm.ren_hall: Pale small-tile walls and terracotta bands, rows of T-shaped windows and outdoor AC units, rounded stair tower and green entrance canopy.
v5.dorm.shi_hall: A hillside entrance with steps, rounded-stone retaining walls, pale tiled building and distinctive dark vertical entrance screen.
v5.dorm.li_hall: Fine grey tiles, rows of T-shaped windows, a vertical red-brown perforated screen and accessible entrance railings.
v5.dorm.yi_hall: White plaster, stacked curved glazing, narrow vertical openings at both sides and blue glass at ground level.
v5.reference_note: Redrawn from official NTHU housing photos
v5.indoor_text: Walk along the central aisle. Approach shelves, desks and facilities, then press E to read or use them.
